text:
mira: Heads-up — I put together a tiny TS monorepo Next starter + eval harness so new hires can try Redwood SDK parity and auth flows quickly.
sam: awesome, can you paste how you wired the SDK in the browser vs server? parity is the pain point.
mira: server: used server-side helper wrapper, basically
mira: ```ts
mira: // packages/api/src/redwoodClient.ts
mira: import { Redwood } from 'redwood-sdk'
mira: export const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })
mira: ```
mira: browser: lightweight client that relies on proxy route with rotation token
mira: ```ts
mira: // apps/web/src/lib/redwoodProxy.ts
mira: export async function fetchWithAuth(path){
mira:   return fetch(`/api/proxy?to=${path}`)
mira: }
mira: ```
jon: Does the proxy still hit retry-on-401 behavior? we had weird double-retry loops earlier.
mira: good catch — the local sample used SDK v0.8 which reattempted token refresh twice. I patched to v0.9 in the monorepo and added a guard.
katie: can you show the guard? we're trying to teach it in the onboarding doc.
mira: short snippet:
mira: ```ts
mira: // in http middleware
mira: if (req.retryCount && req.retryCount > 1) return res.status(401).send('auth-failed')
mira: ```
sam: Nice. Also, add a note about cookies vs localStorage — people default to localStorage and then wonder why server-side SSR fails.
jon: For the eval harness: did you include a minimal LangChain + LlamaIndex example? that helps folks run qualitative checks.
mira: yep — tiny eval that compares generation from local quantized llama and hosted redwood model, with a prompt set in /e2e/prompts.json
mira: eval command in README:
mira: ```bash
mira: yarn workspace:@redwood/eval run --promptSet=e2e/prompts.json --target=hosted
mira: ```
katie: CI note: CI bot should run the eval on PRs to catch SDK regressions early.
ci-bot: running eval job on PR #324 — 3 prompts, 2 models, timeout 30s each
jon: Any flakiness in CI? last time the hosted model timed out intermittently.
mira: added a retry policy toggle in the harness (0, 1, 2) and default is 1 to surface issues without masking them.
sam: Can we add a quick troubleshooting section in README: auth, SSR mismatch, retry loop, CI flake, model timeout?
mira: yes, PR coming. I'll also add a tiny video gif showing the deploy + running eval locally.
katie: sweet. once merged, can you drop the link in #devex and tag the new hire checklist?
mira: will do. thanks all :rocket:
ci-bot: eval job completed — 3/3 prompts returned, 0 regressions detected :white_check_mark:
